question: Rickets is caused due to the deficiency of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**vitamin D.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vitamin-D:**

 
 
• The chemical name of **Vitamin D is Cholecalciferol.**
 
• Its deficiency causes rickets.
 
• It was discovered by **Edward Mellanby.**
 
• It is fat-soluble.
 
• It is **found in Fish, eggs, liver, mushrooms.**
